# Araphor

> Araphor stops harmful AI-agent actions before they take effect.

Araphor enforces approved policy on actions from AI agents and Linux or
Kubernetes workloads. Teams can first observe actions, review suggested
policies, and enable protection when ready.

## Website

- [Product overview](https://araphor.ai/): Product scope, enforcement model, protected actions, and deployment options.
- [Incident replay](https://araphor.ai/#attack-lab): Published AI-agent incidents and possible enforcement points.
- [Request early access](https://araphor.ai/#early-access): Early-access request and demo booking.
